body:
**Pick a face. Pick a voice. Pick a mind. They live on your machine.**

Aether is a desktop AI companion you install and keep. Twelve personas, three interaction modes (chat, voice, video), any LLM you want (100+ providers via litellm), memory that survives restarts, secrets in the OS keyring, MIT license.

## What ships in this preview

- **3 fully-rendered personas** — Aurora (warm · supportive), Caelum (analytical · precise), Luma (playful · witty). 9 additional canonical slots ready for community-built packs.
- **Onboarding wizard** — 8-screen setup, E2E-verified: welcome → avatar → personality → name → LLM BYOK → voice → terms → handoff.
- **Three interaction modes** — streaming text chat, push-to-talk voice (faster-whisper + Chatterbox), video avatar with lip-sync (LivePortrait-ready).
- **Hybrid memory** — BM25 + dense-vector ChromaDB with per-persona isolation.
- **LLM router** — litellm-backed 5-tier routing (FAST / MAIN / HEAVY) across Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, OpenRouter, Aether Guest.
- **Secrets** — OS keyring via the \`keyring\` library; never plaintext.
- **Desktop shell** — pywebview native-window launcher wrapping the Next.js UI.

## Hardware

| Use case | Minimum | Recommended |
|---|---|---|
| Text chat (cloud LLM) | Python 3.13 | — |
| Text + local LLM | 16 GB RAM, 8 GB VRAM | 32 GB RAM, 12+ GB VRAM |
| Local voice | NVIDIA GPU, 6 GB VRAM | 8+ GB VRAM |
| Video avatar | NVIDIA GPU, 8 GB VRAM | 12+ GB VRAM |

## Install

This is a preview — source-install only, packaged installer is the next milestone.

\`\`\`bash
git clone https://github.com/dbhavery/aether.git
cd aether
git checkout dev
python -m venv .venv
.venv/Scripts/activate          # Windows
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Optional — local voice extras:
# pip install -r requirements-voice.txt
# pip install torch==2.7.0+cu128 torchaudio==2.7.0+cu128 \
#     --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128

# Run
python -m src.main                   # terminal 1
cd frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run dev   # terminal 2
# → http://127.0.0.1:3000/
\`\`\`

## What's NOT in v1.0

Tool use / agent workflows, vision, mobile client, photorealistic full-body avatar, real-time barge-in, hosted tier, packaged macOS/Linux installers — all deferred to the v2 rebuild tracked in \`docs/PRODUCT-PLAN.md § 2\`.
